manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Shows a tossed ball rising and falling alongside its velocity-time slope, illustrating that vertical acceleration and gravitational force remain non-zero at the highest point.
manifest.description: Left: A tossed ball moves vertically on a height ruler alongside live velocity and acceleration arrows and a callout of quantities. Right: A velocity-time line with a marker tracking the ball's instant of zero velocity.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
